2607.23219.title: An Ontology for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
2607.23219.paper_summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate quantum-mechanical energies and forces---conventionally computed by density functional theory (DFT) or wave-function methods---at a fraction of the cost. The field encompasses a growing ecosystem of algorithms, training datasets, hyperparameters, and target materials, yet the metadata needed to systematically compare, reproduce, and build upon MLIP studies remains scattered across papers, scripts, and ad-hoc file formats. We present the MLIPs ontology, an OWL 2 DL ontology that captures the concepts needed to describe MLIP methods, their hyperparameters, training datasets with DFT provenance, and published benchmarks. The ontology is organized into three modules---Method, Training Data, and Benchmark---and connects existing ontologies in materials science (MDO, CMSO/ASMO) and machine learning (ML-Schema), complementing dataset-side schemas such as Croissant. It declares 27 formal axioms enforcing data completeness and consistency, including property chains that link trained models to their methods and training data. We demonstrate the ontology through a running example based on Moment Tensor Potentials and evaluate it through competency-question execution on a 20-paper seeded knowledge graph, OWL reasoning, and comparison with existing ontologies.
2607.23219.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習原子間勢能（MLIPs）以較低的成本近似量子力學能量和力——這些通常是通過密度泛函理論（DFT）或波函數方法計算的。該領域涵蓋了一個不斷增長的算法、生訓數據集、超參數和目標材料的生態系統，但系統性比較、重現和基於MLIP研究的所需元數據仍然分散在論文、腳本和臨時文件格式中。我們提出了MLIPs本體論，這是一個OWL 2 DL本體論，捕捉了描述MLIP方法、其超參數、具有DFT來源的訓練數據集和已發表基準所需的概念。該本體論組織為三個模塊——方法、訓練數據和基準——並連接了材料科學（MDO、CMSO/ASMO）和機器學習（ML-Schema）中的現有本體論，補充了如Croissant等數據集側的架構。它聲明了27個正式公理，以強制數據的完整性和一致性，包括將訓練模型與其方法和訓練數據鏈接的屬性鏈。我們通過基於矩量張量勢能的運行示例演示了該本體論，並通過在一個20篇論文的知識圖譜上執行能力問題、OWL推理以及與現有本體論的比較來評估它。
